**Anthropic** is an artificial‑intelligence research and development company that builds safe, reliable, and beneficial AI systems. ### Key facts | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Founded** | 2021 (by former OpenAI employees, including Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, and others) | | **Headquarters** | San Francisco, California (with additional offices in the U.S. and abroad) | | **Mission** | To ensure that advanced AI systems are aligned with human values and that they behave in ways that are safe, trustworthy, and beneficial. | | **Core products** | • **Claude** – a family of large language models (Claude, Claude 2, Claude 3, etc.).
• **Claude Code** – a coding‑focused version of the model.
• **API services** – developers can call Claude’s models via the Anthropic API. | | **Research focus** | • **Constitutional AI** – training models to follow a set of principles derived from human values.
• **Alignment, interpretability, and robustness** of AI systems.
• **Scalable oversight** techniques for large models. | | **Funding & partners** | Backed by venture capital firms (e.g., Sequoia Capital, Google, Amazon, and others). Has strategic partnerships with cloud providers like AWS and Google Cloud. | | **Values** | Safety first, transparency, collaboration with the broader AI community, and responsible deployment. | ### How it works (simplified) 1. **Training data** – Large datasets of text and code, curated to reflect diverse domains and languages. 2. **Constitutional AI** – During training, the model is guided by a “constitution” of principles (e.g., “be helpful, harmless, honest”). This helps the model learn to avoid harmful outputs. 3. **Fine‑tuning & evaluation** – Extensive testing for safety, accuracy, and robustness before release. 4. **Deployment** – The resulting models are offered via an API, allowing developers to integrate Claude into applications, chatbots, coding tools, etc. ### Why it matters - **Safety focus**: Anthropic invests heavily in research on how to make AI systems behave predictably and align with human intent. - **Openness**: While not fully open‑source, the company shares research findings, tools, and best practices with the broader AI community. - **Competitive landscape**: It competes with other major AI labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, etc.) while emphasizing safety‑first development. In short, **Anthropic** is a leading AI lab that creates powerful language models (most notably Claude) while prioritizing safety, alignment, and responsible deployment of artificial intelligence.
